title: Riders paid a median $6.52/mile in Aug 2026

subtitles.fpm_by_mode: Uber had the lowest median fare per mile in Aug 2026, $6.31/mile, and yellow cabs the highest, $7.11/mile
subtitles.fpm_by_hour: Fares per mile were lowest on Sat 6 am ($4.22/mile) and highest on Wed 5 pm ($6.99/mile) over the 3 months to Aug 2026
subtitles.fpm_by_borough: Manhattan had the highest overall fare per mile (total fares ÷ total miles), $6.41/mile across all modes, over the 3 months to Aug 2026
subtitles.volatility_by_zone: Fares per mile varied most for Uber trips from Garment District in Aug 2026, where the 90th-percentile fare per mile was 5.4× the 10th
